digest.component_or_area: CI/CD workflow and complexity baseline enforcement
propositions: The complexity baseline file has no CI lock mechanism, while the module-size limit is protected by a mandatory administrator override gate in the build workflow.
The baseline can grow by adding new entries because the test only validates schema, sortedness, and entry count parity with live functions, not monotonic non-increasing cardinality.
The module-size limit's lock emits a warning and continues when the base value fetch fails, allowing unverified branch values to bypass the cap.

The semantic lock must distinguish legitimate shrinkage (removed or lowered entries) from illegitimate growth (added or raised entries), requiring entry-by-entry comparison rather than byte-equality comparison.
Adding a new function above the C901 complexity threshold can currently be admitted by adding a matching baseline entry, circumventing the gate.
The lock must fail closed when unable to fetch the baseline from main, and the intended change posture must be documented.
